custody.contract: solana/bloch-sol-vault (program); the vault is a program-derived account of the configuration hash, its token account a program-derived account of the vault

fee.collection: accrued in the vault's token account outside the backing; anyone sends sweep_fees and the vault pays the recipient's USDC associated token account 2VMpYFjydEYUu1Jw8KhfxBGDT7zRUkBqjKc6DZziqayg, which must exist first
fee.networkFee: the depositor pays the deposit transaction and the rent of its deposit record (about 0.0024 SOL, not returned); the relayer pays the two release transactions and advances the rent of the release record (about 0.0023 SOL), which returns to it when the record is closed after 7 days

finality.rule: A deposit is attested when its deposit record account is read at finalized commitment, at least 150 slots below the finalized slot, on every Solana endpoint of the signer (at least two, of different operators), and all of them show the same record.
finality.reorg: Signers read only finalized account state. Every mint waits 12 hours on the L2; a mint whose deposit record is gone after a cluster restart is cancelled by the guardians. If it credits anyway, the vault refuses every later burn because the token's mint chain no longer equals the vault's deposit chain: releases are held, nothing is credited twice and nothing is paid without a deposit.

deposit.recipientEncoding: the 20 bytes of the L2 address, in the instruction data after the amount
deposit.function: instruction 1 (deposit) of the vault program: data = 0x01 | amount u64 little-endian | 20-byte L2 address; accounts: depositor (signer, writable), depositor USDC token account (writable), vault (writable), vault token account (writable), USDC mint, deposit record PDA ["deposit", vault, deposit count as u64 little-endian] (writable), token program, system program, then optionally the deposit record PDAs of the next counts (up to 7 more, writable)
steps: read the vault account to learn the deposit count n and derive the deposit record addresses of counts n to n+3 (the program uses the one of the count it finds, so deposits sent at the same time do not fail each other)
send the deposit instruction signed by the wallet that holds the USDC (it also pays about 0.0024 SOL of rent for the deposit record)
after source finality and the 12 hour mint delay the L2 token credits amount less 0.05% to the L2 address
refusals: an amount below minDeposit or above maxDeposit, or one that would pass the cap
a deposit while the vault is paused or deposits are switched off
any token account that is not classic SPL USDC
do not name a contract as the L2 address unless it can move the token

release.l2Function: approve(router, amount) on the token, then burnTo(uint64 amount, string recipient, uint64 nonce, bytes proof) on SolanaBurnRouter (contracts/solana/SolanaBurnRouter.sol, constructor (token, bytes32 solanaMint), address TBD-deploy; creation code keccak256 0xb6ce6ba3d3d6e97ae9f5e21969c47c2ceec6199de141d14915520254b968bea4, runtime pin from sol_vault.py router-pin). recipient = the wallet's base58 address from a CONNECTED Solana wallet; nonce = nextNonce(burner); proof = tag | Ed25519 signature [| application domain] by the destination key over exitMessage(burner, amount, recipient, nonce) (docs/SOLANA-VAULT.md 11.3; vectors deployments/solana/exit-proof-vectors.json). The router refuses what is not a wallet address, checks the proof's shape, consumes the nonce, burns and logs SolanaExit(burnId, from, amount, commitment, recipient, nonce, proof, exitHash). Do NOT call burn(uint64,address) on the token directly
release.recipientEncoding: the wallet's base58 address as text, given to the router. On the token the burn then names a 20-byte commitment: the last 20 bytes of keccak256("BLOCH-SVM-ACCOUNT-ID-v1" || the 32-byte wallet address). The vault pays only the USDC associated token account of the wallet that hashes to it. Commit the WALLET, never a token account
notes: the wallet's USDC associated token account must exist before the payment; relayers do not create it by default, and anyone (the user included) may create it and may send the payment transaction

a release above 1,000 USDC waits 1,800 seconds on Solana between approval and payment; a guardian pause voids approvals not yet paid, and the committee then certifies the burn again: an exit is never lost to a pause

a burn made directly on the token (not through the router) names no destination with a proof: it is HELD by the signers (direct-burn) whatever its 20 bytes are, until its burner (the from of its Burned log) names a wallet with redirectHeldBurn on the router and that wallet's proof; SolanaRecipientRegistry announcements are no longer read
a wallet that is a program-derived address (a multisig vault) is refused by the router: exit to a key wallet

DESTINATION PROOF (part of the exit since round 17): the destination key signs the router's exitMessage line (printable ASCII, no newline: 'Bloch bridge exit v1: pay <amount> units burned by <burner> to my Solana wallet <wallet>. Nonce <n>. Router <router>. Chain <chain id>. Route <route>.'), as raw bytes (tag 0, signMessage), in the Solana off-chain envelope (tag 1, solana sign-offchain-message with a key file) or in the envelope with an application domain and the signer (tag 2: what a Ledger's Solana app signs); the page verifies it itself before approve and passes tag | signature [| domain] to burnTo. The router cannot verify Ed25519 (no precompile on the L2); every signer, the relayer and the guardian verify it from the finalized log, and an exit without a valid proof is HELD and latched. A destination typed or pasted as text is not accepted. Specification docs/SOLANA-VAULT.md 11.3

a mint, a token account, a program id or any account owned by another program is NOT a wallet, even when its address is on the curve and its key signed: the signers read the destination on Solana at finalized and HOLD the burn unless the address is absent from the chain or a System account without data. A hold is LATCHED (it outlives a closed account) and ends only by the burner's redirectHeldBurn to another wallet with a proof, or an operator's logged release-hold. The page should make the same read before burning

HELD exits are recoverable: the burner calls redirectHeldBurn(burnId, wallet, nonce, proof) with the new wallet's proof over redirectMessage(burner, burnId, wallet, nonce); only the burner's own, latest, finalized redirect counts, never after an approval. Unrecoverable: a burn whose burner can no longer send an L2 transaction. Exits go to a wallet you control, never to an exchange deposit address or a token account

states of an exit: read the release record of the burn nonce (address derived from the vault and the nonce; layout docs/SOLANA-VAULT.md 4.4); if it is absent or its first two bytes are zero, read the nonce's bit in the paid page (address derived from the vault and nonce / 8192; layout 4.5): bit set = PAID (the record was closed, from 7 days after payment). Otherwise: approved = payable at ready_at; absent or voided = waiting for signatures, OR HELD. Held is not on chain: it is the signers' decision, reported with its reason by 'sol_vault.py burn-status' (hold: no-wallet | destination-not-a-wallet) and by the reserves monitor; an operator-run status endpoint for pages is not built

relayers never create the token account of an address that is not a funded System account; a wallet whose associated token account was given to another owner, or is frozen by the issuer, cannot be paid until that changes
UNAUDITED. Nothing is deployed. Limits are the Ethereum bridge's launch values, proposed for this network; the owner confirms them before deployment.
custody.address will be the program id and the vault account address, written as <programId>/<vaultAddress>; custody.codeHash the sha256 of the deployed program binary.
Solana-only vault values that the schema's limits do not carry: largeReleaseThreshold 1000000000 and releaseDelay 1800 seconds on the source side, maxValidSeconds 3600.
The source chain id inside every signed message is keccak256("BLOCH-SVM-CHAIN-ID-v1" || genesis hash bytes) = 0x720ef12f64972f1d7a826f17e9d177f041fbca3173c9bce00aa50eac2c22fdec.

The L2 side of an exit is SolanaBurnRouter.burnTo(uint64,string,uint64,bytes), the same shape as StellarBurnRouter and BitcoinBurnRouter; router address TBD-deploy. Its walletOf(string) and commitment(string) are view functions (they read the immutable mint).
Solana-only vault value: recordRetention 604800 seconds (a paid release record may be closed after it; the paid page keeps the nonce spent).

Solana-only tool rules since review 330: recordRetention has a floor of 259200 seconds outside a rehearsal; a vault file with rehearsal true is refused on mainnet-beta, devnet, testnet and for any endpoint that is not on loopback; init creates the fee owner's USDC associated token account when absent (idempotent; anyone may) and verifies it (canonical address, mint, owned by the fee owner); init also requires the fee owner's signed proof (route, cluster genesis hash, purpose, a date at most 30 days old).
